clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Jocaste trains night elf hunters arriving from the wilds of Teldrassil.

Jocaste trains night elf hunters in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. Young trackers come to her after their first training in Shadowglen, ready to take up the hunt in the capital. She teaches marksmanship and survival in the wild, along with the bond between a hunter and the beasts of Kalimdor.
